_what: Values read BY EYE from 3x enlarged crops of src/navionics_garmin_nauticalchart_z17_2026-10-05.png (Garmin Navionics Nautical Chart, metres). Each row = [x_px, y_px in the 1400x900 screenshot, depth in m]. A sounding printed as a big digit plus a small subscript digit (e.g. 2 with subscript 3) is 2.3 m. Pixel read accuracy about +-1.5 px (+-1 m on the ground at zoom 17). Datum not stated by the viewer (assumed chart datum).
